old_problem: DeepSeek-R1 workload is identifiable, but combined Server/Offline command, training toolkit and BERT acceptance make scenario/harness invalid.
disposition_reason: ED-10 forbids a combined `server/offline` scenario because MLPerf defines different rules and metrics. Selecting one would delete the other named coverage; the source owner must choose or create two independent variants. Training/BERT copy defects can then be rejected, but not before scenario identity is authoritative.
decision_basis: Directly read Performance row52 all18 XLSX cells and history2613.
Preserved DeepSeek-R1 inference, model validity, large-memory topology and both named scenario possibilities.
Did not run a combined invalid scenario or silently choose Server/Offline.
No model download or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: MLPerf v5.1 DeepSeek-R1 scenario-specific inference validation
test_case.purpose: Run DeepSeek-R1 under one official Server or Offline v5.1 recipe, or two separately identified variants, with scenario-matched validity and reference.
required_package: Decision selecting Server/Offline or two distinct Source Key/Variant IDs
Licensed model/tokenizer/data/config and GPU memory/topology/runtime/storage profile
test_case.test_command: Do not execute `server/offline`. After scenario authority is supplied, validate official inference artifacts/capacity and run only that scenario's exact model-validity and LoadGen command; preserve full performance/latency/telemetry, restore state and compare to a same-scenario v5.1 reference.
test_case.expected_result: The selected DeepSeek-R1 scenario passes model and LoadGen validity, meets its matched delta and leaves every GPU healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires one explicit scenario per variant, official inference launcher, exact model validity and threshold. Combined, training or BERT evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Validate licenses and aggregate GPU memory/storage.
Abort on OOM, validity, power/thermal or worker failure.
Track all containers/workers; no automatic rerun.
test_case.recovery: If a harness starts the wrong scenario, exhausts model memory or fails distributed validity, stop every tracked DeepSeek-R1 worker, preserve allocation/config/LoadGen logs, release test-created memory/storage state and verify all GPUs before the scenario owner authorizes another run.
